name: @neweditor/desktop
description: Editor Brain — o editor de vídeo do NewEditor.AI, como app de Mac e Windows

scripts.dist: npm run build -w @neweditor/web && node esbuild.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build -w @neweditor/web && node esbuild.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build -w @neweditor/web && node esbuild.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
